_note: The precise voice of each character for VoiceDesign: what the voice IS (sex, age, accent, pitch, timbre, pace, how sentences end), so fewer voices fit it and it drifts less from line to line. Written from each roster profile's voice; Heather's pitch held down (the user: the clone was too high for her). tools/td-vo-render.py --profiles uses these in place of the script's short description.
Heather: Female, 18 years old, General American accent. Medium pitch for a young woman, not high and never squeaky; a clear, slightly nasal, polished tone. Fast, clipped, precise speech with crisp consonants. Sentences end on a firm downward note, dismissive and superior. Confident, cold and condescending; sugary only when she is faking it.
Owen: Male, 18 years old, General American accent. Warm, round baritone with a slightly breathy, chesty sound; a big friendly voice. Speaks loudly and quickly, words tumbling out with enthusiasm; when excited or scared his pitch jumps up and his voice cracks. Goofy, open and good-natured, often on the edge of laughing.
Gwen: Female, 18 years old, General American accent. Low alto for a young woman, slightly husky and smooth. Slow, even, unhurried pace; flat deadpan intonation with very little pitch movement, sentences ending low. Dry and sarcastic, bored with everyone; only softer and warmer when she means it.
